projectContext.description: voiceover-matcher-subtitle: AI-powered pipeline for matching voiceover to stock footage

userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for quality focus area
acceptanceCriteria: Read scripts/ralph/config/ralph-config.json to understand the 'quality' focus area
Read scripts/ralph/session/prompt.md for project context and architecture notes
Read scripts/ralph/state/queue.json for interview details (story outline, architecture decisions, key files)
Read CLAUDE.md for project conventions and known issues
Analyze the codebase to find 8-12 specific improvements for 'quality'
Add stories US-72-002 through US-72-012 to scripts/ralph/state/prd.json (MUST use sprint-prefixed IDs)
Each story MUST have 4-6 testable acceptance criteria
Each story MUST have a 'notes' field with: (1) tier classification, (2) exact source file paths, (3) line number ranges if removing/moving code
IMPORTANT: All generated stories MUST have passes set to false - do NOT run tests or evaluate whether they already pass
IMPORTANT: Story IDs MUST follow format US-72-NNN to be unique across sprints
Mark this story (US-72-001) as passes: true when done
userStories.notes: Seed story completed. Generated 11 stories (US-72-002 through US-72-012) covering the full context-enriched matching and chapter detection feature set. Stories follow the dependency chain: metadata propagation (foundation) -> context-enriched matching + chapter detection (parallel) -> cross-chapter grouping + iterative match (downstream).

userStories.title: Propagate video chapters and tags from CaptionResult to state dataclasses
acceptanceCriteria: Add `video_chapters: List[dict] = field(default_factory=list)` field to VideoSearchResult in src/state.py
Add `video_tags: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)` field to VideoSearchResult in src/state.py
Add `video_chapters: List[dict] = field(default_factory=list)` field to DownloadedVideo in src/state.py
Add `video_tags: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)` field to DownloadedVideo in src/state.py
In src/stages/caption_stage.py `_populate_text_metadata()`, copy video_chapters and video_tags from CaptionResult to the corresponding VideoSearchResult in state
Unit test: verify VideoSearchResult serializes/deserializes with new fields (backward compat with existing checkpoint data that lacks these fields)
userStories.notes: Added video_chapters and video_tags to VideoSearchResult and DownloadedVideo in state.py. Added serialization in caption_stage.py success dict. Added propagation in _populate_text_metadata from caption_results to VSR. 10 tests pass (backward compat, roundtrip, propagation).

userStories.title: Add chapter_index field to TranscriptSegment for segment-to-chapter mapping
acceptanceCriteria: Add `chapter_index: Optional[int] = None` field to TranscriptSegment in src/state.py
Add `chapter_title: str = ''` field to TranscriptSegment in src/state.py
Create helper function `assign_chapter_indices(segments, chapters)` that maps each segment to its containing chapter by timestamp overlap
Handle edge case: segment spanning two chapters is assigned to the chapter with >50% overlap
Handle edge case: segments outside any chapter range get chapter_index=None
Unit test: assign_chapter_indices with segments fully inside, spanning, and outside chapter boundaries
userStories.notes: Added chapter_index: Optional[int] and chapter_title: str fields to TranscriptSegment. Implemented assign_chapter_indices(segments, chapters) in bridge.py using timestamp overlap (>50% rule for spanning segments). 9 new tests cover: fully inside, spanning two chapters (both directions), outside all chapters, empty inputs, gap between chapters, missing title. All 41 bridge tests pass.

userStories.title: Add title keyword overlap scoring to confidence breakdown
acceptanceCriteria: In src/matching/scoring.py, implement `apply_title_relevance_adjustment()` that extracts keywords from voiceover text and video title
Graduated boost: 1 keyword match gives +0.03, 2 matches gives +0.05, 3+ matches gives +0.08
Add result to confidence_breakdown list as {'component': 'title_relevance', 'adjustment': float, 'reason': str}
Skip adjustment when video title is empty or unavailable (adjustment = 0.0)
Call the method from apply_all_adjustments() with video title passed from match candidates
Unit test: verify graduated boost values for 0, 1, 2, and 3+ keyword matches
userStories.notes: HARD STORY: Skipped after 3_failures - pending decomposition

userStories.title: Feed video tags into existing keyword boost mechanism in scoring
acceptanceCriteria: In src/matching/scoring.py, implement `apply_tag_keyword_boost()` that checks voiceover segment keywords against video tags
Reuse the existing keyword_boost logic: if voiceover keywords overlap with video tags, apply +0.02 per matching tag (capped at +0.08)
Add result to confidence_breakdown as {'component': 'tag_keyword_boost', 'adjustment': float, 'reason': str}
Tags must be lowercased before comparison; keywords extracted from voiceover text also lowercased
Call from apply_all_adjustments() passing video_tags from candidate metadata
Unit test: verify tag overlap scoring with 0, 1, 2, 3, and 5 (cap) matching tags
userStories.notes: Pre-implemented in US-71-003. All 6 criteria verified: apply_tag_keyword_boost() at scoring.py:2221 with +0.02/tag capped at +0.08, confidence_breakdown entry with component 'tag_keyword_boost', lowercased tags and keywords, called from apply_all_adjustments() at line 2718. 11 tests pass covering 0/1/2/3/5 tags plus case-insensitive, short-tag filtering, and breakdown integration.

userStories.title: Enrich LLM reranker candidate descriptions with video context
acceptanceCriteria: In src/matching/llm_reranker.py, verify _enrich_candidates_with_context() properly builds context from video_metadata dict
Context string format must be: 'Video context: {title}. {first_sentence_of_description}'
Description truncated to first sentence or 100 chars, whichever is shorter
When video_metadata is empty or title is missing, skip enrichment gracefully (no error, no context prefix)
Wire video_metadata dict construction in the calling code (src/stages/match.py or src/matching/tiered_matcher.py) using state.video_search_results
Unit test: verify enrichment output format, truncation behavior, and graceful handling of missing metadata
userStories.notes: All 6 criteria verified: _enrich_candidates_with_context() builds context from video_metadata dict (llm_reranker.py:206-234). Format: 'Video context: {title}. {first_sentence}' (line 204). Description truncated to first sentence or 100 chars (lines 198-200). Empty/missing metadata handled gracefully with early return (line 217) and empty-string check (line 190). video_metadata wired in match.py:668-692 from state.video_search_results, passed through main.py and tiered_matcher.py. 36 tests pass covering enrichment format, truncation, graceful fallback, metadata construction, and end-to-end flow.

userStories.title: Implement chapter-aware scoring adjustment for topic match/mismatch
acceptanceCriteria: In src/matching/scoring.py, implement `apply_chapter_topic_match()` that compares voiceover chapter keywords with video chapter title keywords
Topic match boost: +0.05 for partial match (1-2 shared keywords), +0.10 for strong match (3+ shared keywords)
Topic mismatch penalty: -0.05 when voiceover chapter has keywords but zero overlap with video chapter
No adjustment when either side lacks chapter data (chapter_index is None)
Add result to confidence_breakdown as {'component': 'chapter_topic_match', 'adjustment': float, 'reason': str}
Unit test: verify all 4 cases - no chapter data, partial match, strong match, mismatch
userStories.notes: Tier 3 (Video-Side Chapter Detection). Source files: src/matching/scoring.py. Depends on US-72-003 for chapter_index on segments and US-72-002 for video_chapters in state. The chapter_topic_match method may already exist as a stub. Keywords from video chapter titles should be extracted the same way as title keywords (split + filter stopwords).

userStories.title: Add chapter-level source consistency boost to scoring
acceptanceCriteria: In src/matching/scoring.py, implement `apply_chapter_source_consistency()` that gives +0.03 boost when a candidate comes from the same video source as the previous segment in the same voiceover chapter
Only apply when both current and previous segments have a valid chapter_index and they match
Within chapter boundaries, this boost should coexist with (not replace) consecutive_source_penalty — net effect may be positive or negative
Add result to confidence_breakdown as {'component': 'chapter_source_consistency', 'adjustment': float, 'reason': str}
Unit test: verify boost applies within same chapter, does not apply across chapter boundaries, does not apply when chapter_index is None
userStories.notes: Tier 3 (Chapter Detection). Source files: src/matching/scoring.py (apply_all_adjustments). This requires knowing the previous segment's match result and chapter_index — the adjustment method needs context about neighboring segments. Config value: chapter_grouping.source_consistency_boost (default 0.03).

userStories.title: Compute cross-chapter relevance matrix for candidate boosting
acceptanceCriteria: Create function `compute_relevance_matrix(voiceover_chapters, video_chapters)` in src/chapter_detection/bridge.py that returns a 2D list of relevance scores
Relevance score per pair: keyword overlap ratio between voiceover chapter topic_keywords and video chapter title keywords, normalized to 0.0-1.0
Handle edge cases: empty keyword lists return 0.0 relevance, empty chapter lists return empty matrix
Wire the matrix into embedding_search.search() via the existing relevance_matrix parameter in src/stages/match.py or src/matching/tiered_matcher.py
Config toggle: matching.chapter_grouping.enabled (default true) controls whether matrix is computed and passed
Unit test: verify matrix dimensions, score normalization, edge cases, and that embedding_search receives the matrix
userStories.notes: Tier 4 (Cross-Chapter Grouping). Source files: src/chapter_detection/bridge.py, src/matching/embedding_search.py (search method ~line 88 already accepts relevance_matrix), src/matching/tiered_matcher.py. Depends on US-72-002 (video chapters in state) and US-72-003 (chapter indices on segments). The embedding_search already has _apply_chapter_boost() — this story just computes and passes the matrix.

userStories.title: Add chapter coherence penalty for scattered source usage within voiceover chapters
acceptanceCriteria: In src/matching/scoring.py, implement `apply_chapter_coherence_penalty()` that tracks unique video chapters used within each voiceover chapter
When a voiceover chapter uses segments from >5 different video chapters, apply -0.03 penalty to additional candidates from new video chapters
Threshold configurable via matching.chapter_grouping.coherence_penalty_threshold (default 5)
Add result to confidence_breakdown as {'component': 'chapter_coherence_penalty', 'adjustment': float, 'reason': str}
No penalty when voiceover chapter structure is not detected (chapter_index is None)
Unit test: verify penalty triggers at threshold, doesn't trigger below threshold, and is absent without chapter data
userStories.notes: Tier 4 (Cross-Chapter Grouping). Source files: src/matching/scoring.py. This is a quality-of-result polish adjustment. Requires tracking state across segments within a chapter — the scoring context needs to accumulate which video chapters have been used per voiceover chapter. Depends on US-72-003 for chapter_index.

userStories.title: Add description-derived search queries for iterative match gap filling
acceptanceCriteria: In src/iterative_match/gap_analyzer.py, add method `derive_queries_from_descriptions(matched_videos, gap_segment)` that extracts key phrases from descriptions of already-matched videos
Extract top 3 noun phrases from video descriptions using simple regex (capitalized word sequences or quoted phrases)
Return these as additional query suggestions alongside existing gap analysis queries
Config toggle: iterative_match.use_description_queries (default true in config.yaml)
Add config field to IterativeMatchingConfig in src/config/sections/matching.py
Unit test: verify query extraction from sample descriptions, empty description handling, and config toggle
userStories.notes: Tier 5 (Enhanced Iterative Matching). Source files: src/iterative_match/gap_analyzer.py, src/config/sections/matching.py (IterativeMatchingConfig), config.yaml. Depends on US-72-002 for description data being available. Simple regex-based phrase extraction is sufficient — no need for NLP libraries.

userStories.title: Add chapter-type-aware query learning to iterative match
acceptanceCriteria: In src/iterative_match/query_learning.py, add `chapter_type: str = ''` field to QueryResult dataclass
Chapter types: 'intro', 'body', 'conclusion', 'listicle_item', 'unknown' (derived from chapter position and listicle detection)
In QueryLearningDB, track success rates per chapter_type in addition to existing per-strategy tracking
When generating new queries, prefer strategies that historically performed well for the current chapter_type
Add method `get_preferred_strategies(chapter_type, top_n=3)` that returns best strategies for a chapter type
Unit test: verify chapter_type tracking, per-type success rates, and strategy preference ordering
userStories.notes: Tier 5 (Enhanced Iterative Matching). Source files: src/iterative_match/query_learning.py (QueryResult, QueryLearningDB). Depends on US-72-003 for chapter indices. Chapter type classification: first chapter = 'intro', last chapter = 'conclusion', chapters with listicle markers = 'listicle_item', others = 'body'. This was already partially implemented in sprint-71 (US-71-012) — check existing code before implementing.
